question: Eroom's Law says approvals per R&D dollar halve every nine years. The paper stops around 2010. Did it continue?
scope_note: The paper's 1950 baseline is not retestable: no pharma R&D series reaches back that far through any retrievable route. Numerator from 1939, denominator from 2005.
